Dead.note: A living good player the Lycanthrope chose, who dies.
Dead.ambiguous: Neither the How to Run nor the summary says whether the Lycanthrope may choose themselves.

Faux Paw.note: The one good player set up to register as evil.
Faux Paw.ambiguous: The wiki does not say whether the Lycanthrope itself can be the Faux Paw player.

reminders.label: Faux Paw
reminders.text: Choose a good player who registers as evil: put [Faux Paw] on them
reminders.reason: This good player registers as evil

reminderMovement.why: The good player who registers as evil is chosen once.

reminderPlaceholders.note: A good chosen player who is not the Faux Paw dies.

reviewed.reason: The chosen player is marked with the death marker, not an unnamed reminder (Trevor’s review).

full.text: The Lycanthrope chooses a living player. If they are good and not marked *FAUX PAW*, they die: mark them *DEAD*, and the Demon kills no one tonight.
full.reason: Says when the Dead token is used (Trevor’s review: TPI’s text is not enough to use it).
